title: Guess the Clicks!
intro.text: A random YouTube video is playing on the TV. How many views does it have? The closest guess gets a point!
guess.title: How many views?
guess.change: You can change it while time is running.
scores.title: Scores
final.title: Final scores
setup.title: One-time setup
setup.text: For real, current view counts UP! needs a free YouTube API key.
setup.step2: Under “APIs & Services → Library”, enable “YouTube Data API v3”.
setup.step4: Paste the key here on the TV under Settings (gear) for “Guess the Clicks!”.
setup.phone: The host still needs to set up this game.
error.title: No videos found
error.quota: The API key's daily quota is used up. It resets tomorrow.
error.key: The API key is invalid or YouTube Data API v3 isn't enabled.
audience.wait: You're in the audience. Guess anyway – just for fun!
